text:
```yaml
name: NuGet Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master, release ]
    tags: [ '[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+' ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [windows-latest, ubuntu-latest]
        include:
          - os: windows-latest
            platform: AnyCPU
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            platform: AnyCPU

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: '6.0.x'

    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    - name: Determine Version
      run: dotnet msbuild SharpCompress.sln /t:determine-version /p:Configuration=Release

    - name: Update Version
      run: dotnet msbuild SharpCompress.sln /t:update-version /p:Configuration=Release

    - name: Build
      run: dotnet build SharpCompress.sln --no-restore -c Release

    - name: Test
      run: dotnet test SharpCompress.sln --no-build -c Release --logger "trx;LogFileName=test-results.trx"

    - name: Pack
      run: dotnet pack SharpCompress.sln --no-build -c Release -o artifacts/

    - name: Push to NuGet
      if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && github.ref_type == 'tag'
      run: dotnet msbuild SharpCompress.sln /t:push-to-nuget /p:Configuration=Release /p:NuGetApiKey=${{ secrets.NUGET_API_KEY }} /p:SkipDuplicate=true
```
